gcm.purpose: Make MediaForge road tests explain exactly what was found, what will change, what will be excluded, and why.
changeNotes: Replaces the always-open filename table with a plain-English result summary and collapsed filename details.
Explains image count, ready count, review count, and filename changes without requiring the operator to infer what Ready means.
Treats Lincoln Textured Bronze as an explicit known exception that is excluded from output rather than guessed.
Allows a safe ZIP to be built from approved files when only known exceptions are excluded, while unresolved unknowns still block export.
